subject: nose picking
title: What If You Always Picked Your Nose?

scenes.text: What if you always picked your nose? Almost everyone does it. Constantly is another story.
In a Wisconsin survey of 254 adults, 91 percent admitted picking, and 1.2 percent did it at least hourly.
Each pick can scrape the thin lining inside your nose, and your fingers bring fresh germs straight in.
In one Dutch hospital study, 54 percent of nose pickers carried staph in their nose, against 36 percent of others.
And two people from that Wisconsin survey had picked a hole right through the wall between their nostrils.
In a mouse study, nose germs reached the brain within 72 hours. Whether that happens in people is still unknown.
